_note: Business-model rewrite of design/marketing/Landing.dc.html at /. The design moved from an escrow marketplace (platform holds funds, takes 10%) to an introductions platform: clients hire and pay architects directly and we take $0. seeds/content_copy.json and seeds/content_blocks.json were extracted from the superseded revision, so they still re-seed the escrow wording — these rows restore the current design verbatim. `delete` removes the two blocks whose natural key the design renamed (the 100%/escrow-backed hero stat and the 'Pick, pay, build' step), so the stale extracted row can't linger beside its replacement. The catalog.Plan rows are the two contract-type cards ('Choose how you engage'), which the design also rewrote.

copy.text: Our engine estimates a typical range for everything from a quick consult to a full stamped set — using scope, add-ons, and a jurisdiction complexity score — so you get a real number up front, not a vague "it depends." Each architect sets their own price from there.
Two ways architects price their work — you hire and pay them directly. Pick what fits how defined your project is.

steps.title: Hire & build
steps.description: Agree a fixed price or hourly rate, hire your architect directly, and receive stamped, permit-ready drawings on a tracked timeline.

value_props.title: Pay directly, by milestone
value_props.description: You contract and pay your architect directly — a deposit, then payments as you approve each milestone. We never touch the funds.

testimonials.name: Marcus Reed
testimonials.quote: We compared three vetted architects in an afternoon. Hiring directly kept it simple, and the drawings were the cleanest our contractor had seen.
